User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page. The specific flaw exists within the gp.ocx ActiveX control. This control has a CLSID of {E2883E8F-472F-4fb0-9522-AC9BF37916A7} and the ProgID Atlcom.get_atlcom. Upon initialization this control copies the values from two parameters into a fixed length buffer.
